q: The spring of a force meter stretches $3.0\,\text{cm}$ when a force of $8.0\,\text{N}$ acts on it. How much does the spring stretch under a force of $20\,\text{N}$?
a: $7.5\,\text{cm}$. The extension is directly proportional to the force, and the force is 2.5 times as great: $2.5 \cdot 3.0\,\text{cm} = 7.5\,\text{cm}$.
